ask: Lane after #552 merges, first in line: move decision-watch from classic.Stop to turn.complete. Skip turns with e.agentId set (subagent turns), as session-board does. Build the python input from the session id the mod already keeps from session.start, and find the transcript the way /dw already does, since turn.complete carries no transcript path. Keep one judge at a time and never block the turn. Drop the stop_hook_active skip, which only Stop has. Tests: a main-turn turn.complete starts a judge; one with agentId does not; a classic.Stop no longer does. Bump the mod's version. Live proof on Windows: a STOP seen line (or its renamed TURN seen line) lands in shadow.log after one real turn. Rewrite decision decision-watch-mod-limits in place and close debt dw-stop-row-unproven with the sec-default finding. No Stop hook row comes back.
note:
Done: #559 (the decision watch judges at turn end), merged Oct 22. Cause found Oct 21: sec-default, the app's own mod, sends every classic.* event past user-tier mods, so decision-watch, which listened only on classic.Stop, never ran on Windows. #559 moved it to turn.complete, which desktop-statusline and session-board already use.

Found Oct 26 (checked at 149f4bc): on a Mac every turn read 'UNKNOWN, the mod raised'. The mod needed `which -a python3 python` to exit 0, and a Mac has no `python`. So the watch has never judged a Mac turn. Fix: #580 (decision-watch finds python one name at a time, 0.0.8), merged Oct 26 in #586 (main e5525a6). It reaches the Mac through c58 (mods update themselves) or a manual `claude plugin update`.

Mac check passed Oct 27 11:35 CDT (local liaison, main 2ca89254): decision-watch 0.0.11 installed; shadow.log holds 160 judged turns on Oct 27, none UNKNOWN or raised.

Unchecked: whether the installed app package differs from the marketplace copies.

Windows read Oct 28 13:48 CDT (shiv's PC session): NOT PROVEN. The newest END line (17:56:37Z) reads "nothing to say (no protected change, no model call)", with no verdict. The six ENDs before it are UNKNOWN because transcript_path was missing. No ALLOW or FLAG in the last 20 lines.

Waits on: one PC session that makes a protected change, then a read of shadow.log for ALLOW or FLAG. The missing transcript_path is a possible defect to check then.

Placed after c23 (triage, Oct 26): only live Mac and Windows checks were left.
